fields.name: clause
fields.value: where (index_sew like '% مقدمة %' or index_sew like '% ابن %' or index_sew like '% خلدون %' ) and (statut=id_notice_statut and ((notice_visible_opac=1 and notice_visible_opac_abon=0)))

fields.name: pert
fields.value: ((index_sew like '% مقدمة %')+(index_sew like '% ابن %')+(index_sew like '% خلدون %')) as pert

fields.name: tri
fields.value: order by pert desc, index_serie, tnvol, index_sew
